title: Deals | The Bridge
description: The Bridge in Astoria does not publish a standing deal list. What's on the store menu changes, and the shop has run its discounts on event days. Here's how to hear about the next one.
lede: We don't keep a standing deal list. Here's how it actually works at 25-15 Broadway.

sections.heading: The menu moves
sections.html: What's on the store menu changes, so a page like this can't keep up with it. The online store is where to see what's on the menu now.

sections.heading: Event days are when the pricing moves
sections.html: The shop has run its discounts around events. Our Customer Appreciation Pop-Up on August 7 and 8, 2026 came with event-day pricing, and exclusive event-day discounts on August 7 only. The Events page is where the next one shows up.

sections.heading: Get on The List
sections.html: Want to hear when something's coming? Get on The List.
